title: Homogeneous realization and degree projection of square-zero tensor boundaries
statement:
Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes with ideal $J=j.\ker$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Assume $J^2=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], the derived-category instances for the canonical module section boundaries [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact], and short exactness of the canonical unit kernel sequence for each $L^d$. Fix $n\ge0$ and the canonical section and coefficient comparisons $D=(a_e,k_e)$ of [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit], with $D$ equal to their explicit construction. Put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$, $N=(j^*L)^n$, $H=H^1(Z,-)$, and let $b_e:H(F\otimes N^e)\simeq H^1(X,\ker\eta_{L^{n(e+1)}})$ be induced by $k_e$ [def-pc-module-pullback, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction, def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For $y:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ set $\Delta_e(y)=\partial_{n(e+1)}((y;a_e^{-1})(1))$, with the canonical section boundary of [def-sc-module-cohomology-boundary, lem-sc-module-section-boundary-exact]. For every $e\ge0$, $f:\mathcal O_Z\to N$ and $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$ there exist commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaves $B,C$, a morphism $p:B\to C$, and a module sheaf $K$ with inclusion $i:K\to B$, such that $0\to K\xrightarrow{i} B\xrightarrow{p} C\to0$ is short exact and products of two local sections in the kernel of $p$ vanish [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module]. For every compatible injective resolution presentation of this sequence, with a degreewise and global-sections short exact horseshoe [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and for every local quotient action $\sigma$, global action $\mu$, induced cohomology action $\rho$ and additive map $\partial$ satisfying: $i(\sigma(p(b))(z))=b\,i(z)$ on all opens; $\sigma$ commutes with restriction; $\mu$ evaluates as the restricted local action; $\rho(c)=H^1(X,\mu(c))$; and $\partial$ is the transported snake boundary preceded by the canonical sections-to-degree-zero comparison [pqf-def-cohomology], there exist $s,t\in\Gamma(X,C)$ and additive maps $P:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^{e+1})$, $P_x:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^e)$, $P_f:H^1(X,K)\to H(F\otimes N^0)$ satisfying
$$P(\partial(st))=b_{e+1}^{-1}\Delta_{e+1}(\lambda^{-1};f\otimes x),\quad P_x(\partial(t))=b_e^{-1}\Delta_e(x),\quad P_f(\partial(s))=b_0^{-1}\Delta_0(f^{\otimes1}).$$
For every $z\in H^1(X,K)$ they also satisfy
$$P(\rho(s)z)=H(\mathrm{mulTensorPowSection}(f,F,e,1))(P_xz),\qquad P(\rho(t)z)=H(\rho_F^{-1};\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x)(H(\rho_F)(P_fz)).$$
No equation expanding $\partial(st)$ as a sum is assumed or asserted.

proof.text: Form B as the sheaf direct sum of the tensor powers of L, with multiplication induced by inverse tensorPowAddIso. Local frames identify it with a polynomial algebra; frame changes act multiplicatively, so it is a commutative algebra sheaf. Form C as the corresponding graded quotient and K as its kernel, using the closed-immersion unit-quotient and ideal-kernel comparisons in every degree. The module-sheaf category is Grothendieck abelian, so its small coproducts are exact (AB4), and summing the degreewise short exact sequences gives the required short exact sequence.

On each line-bundle trivialization, K is the ideal I times a polynomial algebra. Products of two kernel sections have coefficients in I squared and vanish; sheaf separation gives square zero on every open.

Include the transported section f, with its degree-one unitor, in degree n, and x in degree n(e+1), obtaining s and t. Projection of K to degrees n(e+2), n(e+1) and n followed by the inverse canonical coefficient comparisons defines the additive maps P, Px and Pf. The monoidal pullback and tensor-power addition comparisons identify s*t with the transported tensor-product section. Naturality of the section boundary for the degree inclusions/projections gives the three boundary equations. For arbitrary compatible resolutions, rightDerived_triangle_connecting identifies the displayed snake boundary with moduleSectionBoundary, independent of short-exactness proof choices.

The local lift formula and the monomorphism K to B uniquely fix the quotient action on K. For homogeneous s, projection of its action is multiplication on the coefficient degree by f; the coefficient comparison identifies this with mulTensorPowSection f F e 1. For t it is the map rho_F inverse followed by F whiskered with x, after the degree-zero rho_F identification. Cohomology functoriality and coefficient naturality of the affine edge transport these two sheaf action squares to the stated equations for every cohomology class z. These equations identify actions and do not use the derivation identity.

theorem tensorBoundary_graded_realization
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD}
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (n : ℕ)
    (hshort : ∀ d : ℕ, (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
      ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
        (L.tensorPow d))).ShortExact)
    (D : TensorBoundaryComparisonData j L n)
    (hD : canonicalTensorBoundaryComparisons j L hI n = D) :
    let F : Z.Modules := (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n)
    let N : Z.Modules := ((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n
    let H := RingedSpace.moduleCohomology Z.toRingedSpace 1
    let b : ∀ e : ℕ, H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow e) ≃+
        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (kernel ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) :=
      fun e ↦ Iso.addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv (D.k e)
    let δ : ∀ e : ℕ, (𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1)) →
        (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj
          (kernel ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) :=
      fun (e : ℕ) (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1)) ↦
      RingedSpace.moduleSectionBoundary X.toRingedSpace
        (ShortComplex.kernelSequence
          ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
            (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))) (hshort (n * (e + 1)))
        ((x ≫ (D.a e).inv).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))
    ∀ (e : ℕ) (f : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N) (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ N.tensorPow (e + 1)),
    ∃ (B C : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (p : B ⟶ C)
      (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (i : I ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B)
      (hw : i ≫ (commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p = 0)
      (_hS : (ShortComplex.mk i ((commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p)
        hw).ShortExact)
      (_hsq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a b : B.right.obj.obj (op U)),
        p.right.hom.app (op U) a = 0 → p.right.hom.app (op U) b = 0 → a * b = 0),
      ∀ (IA : InjectiveResolution I) (IB : InjectiveResolution (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B))
      (IC : InjectiveResolution (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf C))
      (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex)
      (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0)
      (_hιA : IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map i ≫ IB.ι)
      (_hιB : IB.ι ≫ β =
        (CochainComplex.single₀ _).map ((commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p) ≫ IC.ι)
      (_hH : ∀ k : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
        (HomologicalComplex.eval _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) k)).ShortExact)
      (hΓ : ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
        ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ))).ShortExact)
        (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
        Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (I.val.obj (op U)))
      (μ : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+* End I)
      (ρ : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+*
        Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))
          ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I))
      (δ' : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤) →+
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I)),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) (σ U (p.right.hom.app (op U) b) x)) =
          b * @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) x)) →
      (∀ (U V : X.Opens) (j : V ⟶ U) (f : C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        I.val.map j.op (σ U f x) = σ V (C.right.obj.map j.op f) (I.val.map j.op x)) →
      (∀ (f : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤)) (U : X.Opens) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        (μ f).val.app (op U) x = σ U (C.right.obj.map (homOfLE le_top).op f) x) →
      (∀ f : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤), ρ f =
        ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).map (μ f)).hom) →
      (∀ f : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤), δ' f =
        (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
            (commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf C) ≫
          (IC.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 0).hom ≫
          hΓ.δ 0 1 rfl ≫
          (IA.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) 1).inv).hom
            f)) →
      ∃ (s t : C.right.obj.obj (op ⊤))
        (P : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I) →+
          H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow (e + 1)))
        (Px : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I) →+
          H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow e))
        (Pf : ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I) →+
          H.obj (show Z.Modules from F ⊗ N.tensorPow 0)),
        P (δ' (s * t)) = (b (e + 1)).symm
          (δ (e + 1) ((λ_ (𝟙_ Z.Modules)).inv ≫ (f ⊗ₘ x))) ∧
        Px (δ' t) = (b e).symm (δ e x) ∧
        Pf (δ' s) = (b 0).symm (δ 0 (tensorPowSection f 1)) ∧
        (∀ z : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I,
          P (ρ s z) = H.map (mulTensorPowSection f F e 1) (Px z)) ∧
        (∀ z : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace 1).obj I,
          P (ρ t z) = H.map ((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ x)
          (H.map (ρ_ F).hom (Pf z)))
